```python
import pixeltable as pxt

# Get reference to the existing videos table
videos = pxt.get_table('videos')

# Create a view that extracts frames at 1 fps
# Using pixeltable's built-in frame-extraction iterator
frames = videos.select(
    video=videos.video,
    frame=videos.video.frames(fps=1)
).unnest('frame')

# Register the view
pxt.create_view('video_frames_1fps', frames)
```
